title: JSONL Event Log Schema
description: Documents all JSONL event types for the epic workflow pipeline. Every event has universal fields (schema_v, run_id, ts, event) plus event-specific fields.

planner_dispatched.description: Fields: epic, attempt, tier, model, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens

planner_failed.description: Fields: epic, attempt, error, turns, response_path

verifier_dispatched.description: Fields: epic, attempt, tier, model, adapter, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens

phase_c_dispatched.description: Fields: epic, attempt, model, adapter, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens. Phase C cross-model (Codex) plan verification.

stage4_events.description: Stage 4 (Execution) events. epic_started/epic_complete/epic_failed/github_comment go to epic.jsonl. Story-level events go to stories/{story_id}/story.jsonl.

story_started.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, index

preflight_fail.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, failure_category, description

agent_dispatched.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, tier, model, adapter, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens

agent_complete.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, commit, turns, response_path

agent_failed.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, error, turns, response_path

validation_pass.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, check_type, results[]

validation_fail.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, check_type, results[], failure_category

critique_dispatched.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, critique_type, critique_model, target_model, adapter, role, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens

critique_pass.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, critique_type, critique_model, turns, findings_count

critique_fail.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, critique_type, critique_model, turns, findings_count, findings[]

critique_failed.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, critique_type, critique_model, error. Logged when critique dispatch fails (infra issue).

epic_critique_dispatched.description: Level: epic. Fields: critique_type, critique_model, adapter, role, prompt_hash, prompt_tokens

epic_critique_pass.description: Level: epic. Fields: critique_type, critique_model, turns, findings_count

epic_critique_fail.description: Level: epic. Fields: critique_type, critique_model, turns, findings_count, findings[]

story_complete.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, commit

story_failed.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, attempt, reason

exit_to_human.description: Level: story. Fields: story_id, reason, failure_category, context{}

epic_failed.description: Level: epic. Fields: epic, reason, stories_completed, stories_failed
